rule: Code allowlists are defense in depth only. VERIFIED requires provider-enforced Clone-only credentials/identity and successful negative-access evidence.

kaggle.required_identity: dedicated AI Clone Kaggle account/identity if Kaggle credentials cannot be dataset-scoped

s3.required_identity: dedicated AI Clone access key/role restricted by provider IAM to the AI Clone bucket/prefix only
s3.code_scope: AI_TWIN_STORAGE_BUCKET + MASTER_CLONE/ required; runtime materializer fails closed on bucket/key scope before provider access
s3.runtime_attestation: runpod/runtime_attestation.py: redacted provider classification, drive-free runtime gate, explicit canonical GET and controlled in-namespace WRITE probes
s3.negative_authorization: NOT_VERIFIED: foreign bucket, foreign prefix, and outside-write still require provider-side proof with the production identity

google_drive.required_identity: dedicated AI Clone service identity with access only to the AI Clone folder/shared drive

runpod.required_identity: dedicated AI Clone Runpod API identity/project boundary with no access to non-Clone resources
